headlines.text: That Saturday in 2019, the AEW World Heavyweight Title made its debut as Chris Jericho vs. Adam Page battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on All Out, rated 6.95. The culmination of months of build since Double or Nothing, with Page even riding a horse to the ring ? Jericho's experience won out on the night, though Page's performance was so well-received that Cody publicly called him the best wrestler in The Elite afterward.

On a Wednesday in 2022, back when The Elite vs. United Empire met in a Tournament Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 8.69 ? a genuine showstealer. Chicago's go-home Dynamite before All Out saw Kenny Omega return in full force, hitting Aussie Open's Kyle Fletcher with the One Winged Angel to send The Elite through to the trios final ? then getting jumped by United Empire after the cameras stopped rolling.
Back on this day in 2024, Hikaru Shida vs. Queen Aminata vs. Serena Deeb vs. Thunder Rosa met in a Number One Contender, serving as the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.28 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2019, back when The Lucha Brothers vs. The Young Bucks settled things in a Ladder match on All Out, rated 9.17 ? an incredible outing in a back-and-forth tag team affair, on an outstanding All Out '19 show that earned an overall rating of 8.03. A ladder war that earned the loudest praise of the entire show ? critics singled this out as the best match on the card, a masterclass in everything the two teams could do against each other.
That Saturday in 2024, Moriarty, Mortos & TV touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.29 ? a solid showing.
